finding.text: Proof item "add one check ... Replay a Prompt getting `{sent:{fast}}` then `{sent:{smart}}` then a Reply; ✓ on the newest only, 🧠 `done` after the Reply" is missing: review/diff.patch touches no test file (no `ext/Chat/v2/marks.test.mjs`, nothing added to `ChatV2.test.mjs`).

The required headless shot at 400 and 1200 px with marks showing is missing: this task folder has no `shots/` dir, and the readme still links the old `v2-subclass/shots/chat-v2-marks-and-live-draft.png`.

Nothing in the folder records the TestRunner result or the `grep prompt_of|sent_by_task` check (session.jsonl has only the assign, one log line, a ledger action and a commit), so a fresh agent cannot confirm the proof ran green; no report to `mastermind-dictation-v3` is visible either.

`ext/Chat/v2/readme.md` has a stale sentence about `ChatV2Model` kept as a "tracker"? Check the "Files"/Decisions sections below line 95 for any remaining `prompt_of`/`sent_by_task` or "step 3 moves them" wording; the diff only edits the first bullet and the Try-it line, so unverified leftovers are possible.

The code change itself matches the ask: `marks(p)` reads `p.sent` and returns null when neither seat is set (ChatV2.js:47-49 of the diff), `read()` keeps only the `chat-v3` class line, `reset()` is deleted, and ChatV3.js:163 uses `p.raw`. `Prompt.sent` always returns an object, so `sent.fast` is safe.
The fixture swap is sound: sent lines now target real message ids (`m-1793586471880` fast; `m-1793586760769` fast then smart), and the old-sessions-show-no-marks line is in the readme as asked.
Nothing was said about whether step 3's text in `views-on-messages.md` is wrong; the brief asked for a note either way.

Proof asked for one headless shot of the V2 demo at 400 and 1200 px with marks showing, saved in this dir's `shots/`; the folder has no `shots/` at all (only inbox/past-work/requirements/review/session), so the visual proof is missing and nothing here shows the marks actually render.

`core/Session/Chat/doc/views-on-messages.md:10` and `:43` still say the marks "stay on the task" and are read "through the Prompt message's `prompt` link to its task" (and cite `ChatV2.js:206-224`); with this diff they are stale. The brief says not to edit that file but to tell the owner, so the report to the mastermind must name these two lines, and nothing in the task folder records that it did.

The proof's `grep -n "prompt_of\|sent_by_task" ext/Chat/v2/*.js` and TestRunner result are not recorded anywhere a fresh agent can read (the log only shows "19/1…" truncated, and `ChatV2.js` in the main tree still has the old Maps until this merges); add the grep output and the TestRunner line to `session.jsonl` or a short `done.md`.

`ChatV2.test.mjs` (diff line 87): `check("🧠 turns done once the Reply …", true)` is a constant pass. The preceding `waitForSelector` does throw on failure, so it is covered, but the check should assert the selector result so a failure reads as a FAIL line.

The requested "✓ on the newest Prompt only" scenario is covered by the fixture (sent lines on `m-1793586471880` and `m-1793586760769`), not by the new live checks; fine, but the test name doesn't say so.

`ChatV2.read()` is now just `classList.add` + `super.read`; kept as the brief instructed (the `chat-v3` class), and `reset()` was correctly deleted. `ChatV3.js` `p.said` to `p.raw` change is correct (`said` is an alias, Prompt.js:44).
